theorem: Let Qp<=Q be PSD on C^D, mu=trQ/D>0, eta=trQ²/(Dmu²)-1>=0, tr(Q-Qp)/trQ<=delta<1. Then dim kerQp /D <= [2delta+eta+sqrt(eta²+4eta delta(1-delta))]/[2(1+eta)].
proof: P=projection ker Qp, t=rank P/D; 0<=tr(PQ)<=tr(Q-Qp). Centered Hilbert-Schmidt Cauchy implies tr(PQ)>=mu D[t-sqrt(eta*t*(1-t))]. Thus t-sqrt(eta*t*(1-t))<=delta. Solve quadratic in t; valid for delta<1, eta>=0.
limitation: Sharp in abstract Q/Qp trace moments. Not proven optimal under the stronger decomposed-frame constraints, and not a proof of H8 or RH.
